channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Donald Trump | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Donald Trump from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Hakeem Jeffries on Donald Trump
item.description:
Jeffries said during the interview, which aired on CNN.

“But why does Donald Trump always have to ruin a good thing, like literally the Knicks haven’t been in the finals for 27 years,the city is trying to celebrate. We’re trying to embrace this and this guy has to inject himself.”

Hakeem Jeffries on Donald Trump, Jun 8, 2026. Source: The Hill.

item.title: Adam Silver on Donald Trump
item.description:
“We’re seeing that in New York and I think President Trump is very much a New Yorker, and I’m thrilled that yet another New Yorker wants to participate in the enthusiasm and the joy around this Knick team.”

Adam Silver on Donald Trump, Jun 5, 2026. Source: The Guardian.

item.title: Adam Silver on Donald Trump
item.description:
NBA Commissioner Adam Silver on President Trump attending Game 3 of the NBA Finals:

“President Trump is very much a New Yorker. I’m thrilled another New Yorker wants to participate in the enthusiasm and the joy around this Knicks team.”

Adam Silver on Donald Trump, Jun 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Craig Hodges on Donald Trump, Joe Biden
item.description:
Whether it’s Trump or Biden, Obama or Bush, Hodges believes the real decision-makers wear tailored suits on Wall Street — not the White House.

“To me, Trump and Biden? It’s a uniparty. Two wings of the same bird,”

Craig Hodges on Donald Trump, Joe Biden, May 13, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Adam Silver on Donald Trump
item.description:
Asked what Trump’s government should focus on regarding sports and media content, Silver expressed how vital freedom of expression is.

“There are lessons that have been learned from President Trump’s first term, as well as from President Biden’s time in office. It’s worth noting that several of Trump’s supporters are influential figures in major media platforms. I believe the direction for the United States should involve re-emphasizing the importance of freedom of expression, and this extends to NBA players voicing their political opinions,”

Adam Silver on Donald Trump, Jan 23, 2025. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Donald Trump
item.description:
Milwaukee Bucks head coach Doc Rivers gave his thoughts on Donald Trump's election win, saying Americans must stand behind the next president.

“Donald Trump is our president, and we're going to have to support him. We want him to do the best job for the country at the end of the day,”

Doc Rivers on Donald Trump, Nov 8, 2024. Source: FOXnews.com.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Donald Trump
item.description:
Barnes tells Scoop B Radio.

“I would DEFINITELY interview Donald Trump. Just because I want to ask him some real questions. That’s it.”

Matt Barnes on Donald Trump, Oct 6, 2024. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Donald Trump
item.description:
Steve Kerr:

“In the words of Stephen Curry,on November 5th we're going to tell Donald Trump ‘Night, Night’”

Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Donald Trump, Aug 20, 2024. Source: Twitter @TommyBeer.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Donald Trump
item.description:
“The vast majority of people in this country, regardless of party affiliation, agree with common sense gun safety measures. Eighty percent of … Americans believe in universal background checks. We know that there’s no way Donald Trump would even attempt to actually get some legislation that would lead to that,”

Steve Kerr on Donald Trump, Jun 7, 2024. Source: The Hill.

item.title: Jonathan Isaac on Donald Trump
item.description:
(Former President Donald J. Trump was vaccinated in January, but states that he won in the 2020 election have much lower vaccination rates than those that favored President Biden.) On Monday, Isaac disputed the magazine’s characterization of him.

“I’m not anti-vax. I’m not anti-medicine. I’m not anti-science. I didn’t come to my current vaccination status by studying Black history or watching Donald Trump press conferences,”

Jonathan Isaac on Donald Trump, Sep 28, 2021. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Donald Trump
item.description:
“I don’t have a lot of faith that the 25th Amendment is going to be invoked. This impeachment will say a lot. If anything, it will bring people together rather than be divisive. It will bring people together who may have thought a different way and realize what Trump can really do and what he really is. So I’m all for it. It’s a good move.”

Gregg Popovich on Donald Trump, Jan 13, 2021. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Draymond Green on Donald Trump
item.description:
“I didn’t understand what the popular vote and the electoral college actually means. So really getting educated and understanding the entire process, that’s what triggered it for me. I will 100% vote this year. Trump won Michigan last time; that’s ridiculous. He and the state of Michigan have nothing in common. … It was decided by 10,000 votes, and look at the people of my ethnicity, my age group, who didn’t vote. So we’re trying to bridge that gap and educate my peers on the importance of getting out to vote.”

Draymond Green on Donald Trump, Oct 30, 2020. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Michele Roberts on Donald Trump, Jared Kushner
item.description:
“If you think for one second that I spend time worrying about what Donald Trump and Jared Kushner say about our players, think again,”

Michele Roberts on Donald Trump, Jared Kushner, Oct 30, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Donald Trump, Joe Biden
item.description:
Gregg Popovich:

“Now it's time for you to decide where you stand. For me it's pretty simple: a vote for Donald Trump is a vote against the very ideals upon which our democracy was founded. Our democracy is at stake, so please stand with me, united in the land of the free and the home of the brave. I stand with Joe Biden.”

Gregg Popovich on Donald Trump, Joe Biden, Oct 29, 2020. Source: Kens5.com.

item.title: Sam Dekker on Donald Trump
item.description:
“I can’t stand him. He did some bulls— on the bus one day. He was talking some [Donald] Trump s— and I wasn’t having it.”

Sam Dekker on Donald Trump, Oct 26, 2020. Source: CavaliersNation.com.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Donald Trump
item.description:
“When he first started to run, I said Donald Trump is the best thing to happen to politics because he speaks his mind. I basically he doesn't give a (expletive). He's not a politician. I had no inkling that he might win,”

Mark Cuban on Donald Trump, Sep 30, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Donald Trump
item.description:
So, to make his point more emphatic, Rivers took off his mask.

“What stands out to me is just watching the Republican convention and they are spewing this fear. All you hear is Donald Trump and all of them talking about fear,”

Doc Rivers on Donald Trump, Aug 26, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: JJ Redick on Donald Trump
item.description:
“First of all, I don’t think anybody in the NBA cares if President Trump watches basketball. I couldn’t care less,”

JJ Redick on Donald Trump, Jul 31, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Braeden Anderson on Donald Trump
item.description:
“(President Donald) Trump is doing that, and white supremacy is becoming normalized. COVID-19 masks are political? Black people being profiled is political? “I want to stop that trend.”

Braeden Anderson on Donald Trump, Jul 8, 2020. Source: Forbes.com.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Donald Trump
item.description:
“That’s why I told you (back then) I wanted to see where they were going, and nothing happened. That’s what I told you, ‘Hey listen, I’m going to give them a chance,’ and they talked really good, but nothing happened. I wanted to listen. They (talked) prison reform, trying to help minorities get businesses started was one of my priorities, and nothing happened. I gave ’em a chance. I’m not a Trump guy, but I gave ’em a chance. As usual, everybody talks a good game.”

Charles Barkley on Donald Trump, Jun 24, 2020. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Donald Trump, Joe Biden
item.description:
“In a three-way between me, Biden and Trump, I dominated the independent vote — I got like 77 percent percent of it and was able to take some votes away from Donald and some votes away from Biden. But in aggregate, I was only able to get up to 25 percent. From every which way, crosstab, you name it, I had it analyzed and scrutinized every which way, projected, and they could only see me getting up to 25 percent. That’s why I didn’t pursue it further.”

Mark Cuban on Donald Trump, Joe Biden, Jun 4, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Donald Trump
item.description:
“What they found out is I’d take some votes away from Donald Trump, particularly with independents,”

Mark Cuban on Donald Trump, Jun 4, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Donald Trump
item.description:
Cuban said of his message to Trump.

“I think what’s missing and what I’ll say to him the next time we convene, is we need a task force that deals with all the little things that are required to open up any business. It’s not just about opening up an arena, but when we have any type of opening.”

Mark Cuban on Donald Trump, Apr 18, 2020. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: JJ Redick on Donald Trump
item.description:
Tomer Azarly:JJ Redick on Lob City Clippers' demise -

“Off the court, everybody got along & then there was just so much pettiness. So much pettiness. It’s weird to think what we had the potential to accomplish & what ultimately derailed that was pettiness. Like Donald Trump-level pettiness.”

JJ Redick on Donald Trump, Apr 10, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Donald Trump
item.description:
“If you’re a former player and what happened to me when they [dragged] me out of there for no reason, and we got the tape and I didn’t do nothing, it’s like lynching somebody back in the ‘40s and ‘50s. [Dolan] don’t care. I hate to put him in the category of Donald Trump, I think he’s Trump’s nephew. He don’t care.”

Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Donald Trump, Mar 4, 2020. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Donald Trump
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Trump's criticism:

“I was the shiny object yesterday. There was a new one today. They'll be a new one tomorrow. The circus goes on.”

Steve Kerr on Donald Trump, Oct 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom on Donald Trump
item.description:
“I feel like Trump definitely should talk about these issues with what’s going on in Turkey because there are lots of reports of people getting kidnapped, getting tortured in jail, getting killed,”

Enes Kanter Freedom on Donald Trump, Jan 17, 2019. Source: Reuters.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Donald Trump
item.description:
“I think (Trump) has been the worst person that I can remember for race relations,”

Doc Rivers on Donald Trump, Oct 30, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: JJ Redick on Donald Trump
item.description:
JJ Redick on Pardon My Take:

“I don’t think there was one moment. Doc used to always talk about how when one group was together for a long period of time,instead of getting closer together you end up pointing fingers at each other. It was weird because separately everybody was really cool with each other, off the court everybody sort of got along. And then, there was just so much pettiness, it was just pettiness. It’s weird to think what we had the potential to accomplish and what ultimately derailed that was pettiness. Like, Donald Trump-level pettiness.”

JJ Redick on Donald Trump, Aug 24, 2018. Source: podcastone.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Donald Trump
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Donald Trump's gun comments yesterday:

“I think he forgot what side he was on... Reminded me of Anchorman when Brick winds up on the wrong side.”

Steve Kerr on Donald Trump, Mar 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.
